run_launch_program: run a launchpad program using multiple local processes with optional resource configuration
run_launch_with_resources: run a launchpad program with per-group local resource mappings for node configuration
run_launch_with_terminal: run a launchpad program using a specified terminal emulator for process output
run_launch_initialize_context: run a launchpad program that initializes launch context for all nodes in each group
run_launch_bind_addresses: run a launchpad program that binds addresses and connects input handles across nodes
